verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer platform with an SDK, CLI and dev server, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented setting, flag or environment variable for disabling telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting, bring-your-own-key encryption middleware and run observability are related features but are not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
